mapper.select: /* JournalIntrptMapper.getDeletedById */ SELECT intrpt.id, intrpt.created_by, intrpt.journal_dream_id, intrpt.sort_order, day.id AS journal_day_id, day.yy, day.mnth FROM journal_intrpt intrpt LEFT JOIN journal_dream dream ON intrpt.journal_dream_id = dream.id LEFT JOIN journal_day day ON dream.journal_day_id = day.id WHERE intrpt.id = #{id}
